rules.title: Cancellation
rules.text: Cancel at least 12 hours before your class starts. Later cancellations aren't possible.

rules.title: Booking limit
rules.text: You can hold up to 3 upcoming bookings at a time.

rules.title: Waitlist
rules.text: When a class is full, join the waitlist on the website, mobile website or Android app. If a spot opens, the first eligible person is booked automatically.

rules.title: Check-in
rules.text: Check in with the QR code in the Android or iOS app, from 30 minutes before class until 15 minutes after it starts.

rules.title: Mats
